data.one_liner: Utility functions and validators for Flutter form fields
data.what_it_does: Provides a set of reusable form field validator functions inspired by Angular Validators. It covers common validation rules such as required fields, email formats, numerical ranges, character length limits, regular expressions, and field matching.
use_when: You need a quick and straightforward way to validate TextFormField inputs
You want to combine multiple validation checks using a compose utility
avoid_when: You are using a heavy form-building state library that includes its own complex validation engine
strengths: Easy to compose multiple validators together
Includes a wide array of built-in validation rules like email, min/max length, and pattern matching
weaknesses: Limited to string-based form field validation
